summary: Western Sydney University gives every new international student it selects at its Sydney City Campus in 2027 at least A$5,000 a year off tuition, and A$10,000 a year for stronger academic records. It lasts up to two years for a master's and three for a bachelor's. There is no form: you are considered when you apply, and places go first come, first served.
meta_title: Western Sydney City Campus Scholarship 2027: up to A$10,000
meta_description: Western Sydney University takes A$5,000 or A$10,000 a year off tuition for new international students at Sydney City Campus in 2027, while places last.
covers: A tuition fee waiver of A$10,000 or A$5,000 a year, depending on your academic record. Every successful applicant gets at least A$5,000.
Postgraduate coursework: up to two years (A$20,000 or A$10,000). Undergraduate: up to three years (A$30,000 or A$15,000).
eligibility: International students on a student visa (subclass 500), not citizens or permanent residents of Australia or New Zealand, paying their own fees.
Starting a new CRICOS-registered course at Western Sydney University's Sydney City Campus for the first time in 2027: a 1, 1.5 or 2-year postgraduate coursework degree, or an undergraduate degree.
Not eligible with large advanced standing (more than 80 credit points for postgraduates), as a research student, as a current Western Sydney student, or on exchange.
how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible course at Sydney City Campus starting in 2027. There is no separate scholarship application.
Awards are made first come, first served until places are filled, so apply early.
The first payment is applied after the census date of your first session.
watch_out: It does not cover living costs, accommodation, transport or health cover.
You must keep at least three units each session and a cumulative GPA of 4 or higher.
costs: Reduced by A$5,000 or A$10,000 a year
documents: An application for an eligible Sydney City Campus course starting in 2027
Academic transcripts for the merit assessment

faq.q: Do I apply separately for the Sydney City Campus scholarship?
faq.a: No. You are considered automatically when you apply for an eligible course starting in 2027.

faq.q: How much is it worth for a master's?
faq.a: A$10,000 or A$5,000 a year for up to two years.
No closing date is given; places go first come, first served until they are filled.
